Alex — looping in technical notes and attaching a prefilled SIG workbook (v1) with our current answers and outstanding questions (see tab 'Open Items'). High level:

- Logs: Default hosted retention includes request_id, user_id (if provided), timestamp, model, token counts, and outcome codes; system events include auth events and role changes. The default export is CSV/JSON for 90 days.
